tasks.title: Run the manual tenant validation workflow against a non-production Microsoft 365 tenant
tasks.description: Execute `.github/workflows/release-tenant-validation.yml` or `build/run-tenant-validation.ps1` with the required certificate-backed app identity so the repository's read-only Exchange Online and Microsoft Graph validation probes can complete.
tasks.blocker: Requires a real non-production tenant plus the certificate and GitHub secrets referenced by the workflow, which are not present in the repository or local context.
acceptance_criteria: The tenant validation workflow completes successfully and uploads `artifacts/tenant-validation/tenant-validation-report.json`.
The report records zero failed probes for the enabled Exchange Online and Microsoft Graph checks.

tasks.title: Run the unified setup EXE on a real 32-bit Windows host or VM
tasks.description: Execute `artifacts/packages/OnlyExo365.Setup.exe` on a 32-bit Windows machine and confirm that the installer selects the `artifacts/publish/win-x86` payload, preserves a single uninstall entry during reinstall, and uninstalls cleanly.
tasks.blocker: The current local verification context is a 64-bit Windows host only; no 32-bit Windows machine or VM is available in the repository context.
acceptance_criteria: The setup EXE installs the x86 payload on 32-bit Windows.
Reinstall keeps one Programs and Features entry for the product.
Uninstall removes the payload and uninstall registry entry cleanly on the 32-bit host.

tasks.title: Validate upgrade behavior from an ExchangeAdmin-branded install to the OnlyExo365-branded installer on a real Windows host
tasks.description: Install a pre-rename ExchangeAdmin build, then upgrade it with `artifacts/packages/OnlyExo365.Setup.exe` and confirm the unchanged AppId, previous install directory reuse, configuration fallback, uninstall entry continuity, and uninstall cleanup behavior on a real Windows machine.
tasks.blocker: The current repository context does not include a provisioned host with a previously installed ExchangeAdmin build to exercise a real in-place upgrade path.
acceptance_criteria: An ExchangeAdmin-branded installation upgrades in place with the OnlyExo365 setup EXE without creating duplicate uninstall entries.
The upgraded install remains launchable and retains the expected configuration/data paths or documented fallback behavior.
Uninstall after upgrade removes the registered product and the documented default data roots cleanly.
